scope: Web MileageBoard + Mini mileage-board; no API, database, PK calculation or permission changes
keyBehaviors: Five independent date ranges and Beijing calendar navigation
Exact group IDs: all, permanent group, unassigned, deleted group 404 fallback
Four group cards by default; expansion does not request data; folding preserves a selected later group
Member return retains group, date and range; old account/route responses are ignored
Permission-scoped group management and original reporting flows retain their checks
limitations: Mini images are browser source mirrors of actual component state with approximated native controls, not WeChat device captures.
Web component screenshots temporarily hide the parent sticky header only during capture.
